## Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to friday-starter! Please ensure your PR meets the following requirements:

### Pre-submission Checklist
- [ ] I have read and followed the [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] This PR has a descriptive title and clear description of changes
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally and they work as expected
- [ ] I have added/updated tests for my changes (if applicable)
- [ ] I have updated documentation (if applicable)

### Type of Change
Please check the type of change your PR introduces:
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code style/formatting changes
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring (no functional changes, no api changes)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvements
- [ ] 🔧 Configuration changes
- [ ] 🧪 Test changes
